inputs.label: Metroid Prime disc image (NTSC-U, revision 0)
inputs.help: Your own disc image of Metroid Prime, USA version 1.0 (revision 0), as .iso, .nkit.iso, .gcm, .ciso, .gcz, .rvz, .wia, .wbfs, .tgc or .nfs.

steps.text: Open PrimedGun from Library > Unknown Sources. Select your disc image in the launcher and tap Play. The first launch builds shaders for 2 to 3 minutes. When you quit, press Exit Game in the VR menu twice so the shaders are saved.

notes: The guide says the newer tags (v1.1.7-windows, primedgun-2.0-downloads) are not Quest APKs; qgp skips releases without a matching asset and picks v1.1.7. A disc check (gameId) is left out because the guide does not give the game ID and most accepted formats are compressed.
